title: Body Weight Home Training
author: Leiden P.
desc:
Build general fitness, full body strength and balance office job deterioration.😉

Always start with a warmup, alternate even and odd exercises between sets, go to failure in each set, wait 20 sec and go to failure again, then alternate and come back for the second set later.
